name: Perturb
subtitle: that's starting to get annoying
rules: Look at an opponent's hand and pick a non-resource card in it. That player discards that card. You may pick a card of the same type as the discarded card. If you do, put it into its owner's hand.

name: Derelict Seafarer
subtitle: it's hardly an ideal world
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 3 influence. Put a random card from your discard pile into your hand. -- RETIRE – [G][G][G] -- COST – Use this only while this card is not in a battle. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Flip this card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 3 [G]
flavor: In an ideal world, I'd have all 10 fingers on my right hand so my left hand would just be a fist for punching.

name: Stupidify
subtitle: when i snap my fingers you will be...stupid!
rules: An opponent discards 2 cards. -- RECUR – [O] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. -- EFFECT – An opponent discards a card.

name: Department of Rejections
subtitle: nope
rules: Your opponents must pay 2 to search their deck. -- Your opponents must pay 2 to use a character's ability. (This includes abilities used when the character is not in play.) -- FLIP UP – 1 [G]

name: Caboodling Gladhander
subtitle: hey! great to see you ol' pal!
rules: EXTRA COST – You may pick a character. -- When this card enters play, if you picked a character as part of its cost, destroy that character. That character's controller's faction gains X influence, where X is the strength of that character.
